name: VIBRATORY SIEVE SHAKER
desc: The INNOLAB INSTRUMENTS INNO-VRSS-250 Vibratory Sieve Shaker is a rugged, high-frequency grading machine engineered for civil engineering, agriculture, and construction material testing labs. It is fitted with an enhanced vertical vibration motor that creates powerful inclined three-dimensional vibrations, allowing it to efficiently sort coarse aggregates, soils, and grains down to 10 microns.
principle: The INNOLAB INSTRUMENTS VIBRATORY SIEVE SHAKER operates on the principle of high-frequency three-dimensional vibratory motion generated by a vertical vibration motor. This motion creates an inclined elliptical oscillation that causes particles to stratify and pass through mesh openings according to size. The shaker is designed for grading coarse aggregates, heavy soils, grains, and industrial raw materials down to 10 microns, in compliance with standards such as ASTM C136, ASTM D422, and ISO 3310. Civil engineers use it to determine particle size distribution of construction aggregates; agricultural scientists grade grains and seeds; geotechnical labs analyze soil gradation for foundation design; and material researchers assess powder consistency. The 1400 r/min frequency with 1-4 mm amplitude ensures efficient separation without particle degradation, while the stainless steel housing resists corrosion from abrasive or slightly acidic sample residues.
sop: Ensure the vibratory sieve shaker is placed on a stable, level bench and connected to a 220V 50Hz power supply.
Select the required test sieves (200 mm diameter) and stack them in descending mesh size order, placing the coarsest sieve on top and the finest above the collecting pan.
Pour a representative dry sample (typically 200-500 g depending on material) into the top sieve, then place the stainless steel lid on top.
Secure the entire sieve stack onto the shaker platform using the supplied clamping device and rods, ensuring the stack is firmly held without excessive force.
Press the 'SET' button once on the programmable timer to enter time-setting mode.
Use the 'UP' and 'DOWN' arrows to adjust the required shaking duration (e.g., 10 minutes for aggregates, up to 999 minutes for fine powders).
Press 'SET' again to lock the time value and exit setting mode.
Switch on the main power and press the start button to begin vibration. Observe that the stack shakes with a uniform three-dimensional motion.
After the timer reaches zero, the shaker stops automatically. Wait for complete cessation of motion before unclamping.
Carefully remove the sieve stack, weigh the retained material on each sieve, and record results for particle size distribution analysis.

SAFETY WARNING: Always ensure the clamping device is fully tightened before starting the shaker; never operate without the lid and pan in place, as loose sieves can eject and cause injury. Do not overload beyond 5 sieves or exceed 500 g per sieve to prevent motor strain and uneven separation.
